title: Headless Media Contract And Studio Runner Foundations
description:
Lay the additive foundations for computing the OS media graph headlessly, per the approved plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-goal-of-this-eager-stream.md.

Scope for this ticket (deliberately narrowed to avoid colliding with two concurrently-open tickets — UNIFY-MEDIA-LATTICE-WITH-RESOURCE-REGISTRY and GRAPH-AWARE-RECONCILE-FOR-OS-PROJECTION — which are actively editing the MediaType lattice / OsMediaPort.resource_kind region and the reconcile region in the same two files):

1. framework/core/rs/lib.rs: new additive `//#region Media` (separate from the existing MediaType lattice region) defining Media, MediaPayload (Structured{schema,json} | Binary{format,blob_hash}), MediaFingerprint, MediaError, and a MediaConverter trait. Pure addition, no edits to existing MediaType/MediaPortSpec code.
2. framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs: DocumentApp trait (~line 2618) gains four DEFAULTED methods: media_ports() -> Vec<MediaPortSpec>, export_media(port, doc) -> Result<Media, MediaError>, import_media(port, media, doc) -> Result<ActionEmit<Op>, MediaError>, media_fingerprint(port, doc). Defaults must not change behavior for any existing app (return NotImplemented/empty by default).
3. New crate framework/product/os/run/rs (semio-framework-os-run): single lib.rs with regions. Define MediaNodeHost trait (instantiate/load_document/import_media/export_media/media_fingerprint/read_document), StudioRunner, RunState/NodeRunRecord, and studio bundle load/save (studio.os.json + documents/ + run/state.json) working against the CURRENT OsMediaPort.resource_kind: String field (do not rename it — that belongs to UNIFY-MEDIA-LATTICE ticket). A WasmtimeNodeHost impl wired to framework/plugin/host/rs's WasmPluginRuntime, behind the MediaNodeHost trait (wasmtime never leaks out). Add the crate to root Cargo.toml workspace members.
4. Wire `bun run script.ts os run <bundle>.studio [--dry]` in root script.ts, and add a matching entry to .vscode/launch.json.

Do NOT touch: framework/core/rs/lib.rs's existing MediaType/MediaPortSpec code, framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs's resource registry region or OsOp::reconcile, world.wit, or any per-app crate. Those are follow-on tickets once the two concurrent tickets above close.

Verify with `cargo check -p semio-framework-core -p semio-framework-plugin -p semio-framework-os-run` (confirm exact package names first) and a StudioRunner unit test that runs a hand-built two-node graph in-process (no real wasm plugin needed — inject a fake MediaNodeHost) showing dirty/clean fingerprint-based cutoff behavior.
